data.one_liner: Add animated, glowing, and gradient borders to any Flutter widget.
data.what_it_does: Zo Animated Border provides a collection of customizable widget wrappers that add animated border effects—such as gradients, fire, glowing edges, pulsing, and zig-zag lines—around any Flutter child widget.
use_when: You need eye-catching animated borders around buttons, containers, or profile pictures.
You want built-in specialized border effects like fire, breathing, or snake animations without writing custom custom painters.
avoid_when: You only need simple static borders with solid colors or standard radius shapes.
You are concerned about rendering performance overhead of multiple complex concurrent path animations in large lists.
strengths: Large variety of creative, ready-to-use animated border types.
Supports custom durations, colors, curves, and border widths.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on heavy custom painting and animation controllers, which might impact performance if overused.
No platform-specific or backend integration features provided.
data.minimal_example:
ZoAnimatedGradientBorder(
  borderRadius: 100,
  borderThickness: 4,
  gradientColor: [
    Colors.yellow,
    Colors.orange,
  ],
  child: Container(
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    alignment: Alignment.center,
    child: Text("Circle"),
  ),
);
